(In the code I posted last night, I forgot to NOT use a couple of cute little utility functions. Sorry, viewers.
I've now tested this code in vanilla mode. You should have no problem running it with runApp().)
==========

Hello shiny friends,

In the app attached (which is based on the shinysky jstree example),
the jstree is placed directly in the shinyUI, and it responds to javascript
 - the openTree() function works (and the binding to "ready" event inside the tags$script() works)
 - the conditionalPanel condition works
 - the shinyalert report on selected node works.
However, the jstree is not reactive; clicking the button does not change the tree.

If the jstree is instead wrapped in a reactiveUI() call and presented with uiOutput,
now the button works; the node changes; we have reactivity.
However, all 3 of the JS responses are lost.
It seems that JS cannot find the tree, which in jQuery is ("#jstree1").

But, in the debugTools panel, if you type in openTree(), click "JS", and click "evaluate",
the tree does open. The function was defined and is correct.
The binding to ready() does not work, though;
clicking changeTree changes the tree but it does not open automatically after the "ready" event.
This is mystifying.

I am somewhat confident this problem is not specific to jstree, but could be wrong.

Help greatly appreciated, since my application needs reactivity and JS responsiveness. 

Incidentally, the debugTools panel has been really helpful over and over. Highly recommended.
More on this later.
